description: This file defines the core synchronization engine ('SyncEngine') for note data in the application. It manages synchronization states, tracks sync progress, handles connectivity status, and performs push/pop of notes between local repository and remote server. Also, it defines related enums and state classes used within the sync process.

classes.name: SyncEngineState
classes.description: Represents the current state of the sync engine, including status, message, and timestamp of last completion.

methods.name: SyncEngine.syncNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate synchronization process, pushing local changes to remote and pulling remote updates, handling connectivity status, and managing retries on failure.

methods.name: SyncEngine.dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the sync engine, such as timers and stream controllers.
